title: Test 7–9 — Units 7, 8 and 9
subtitle: Checkpoint after Units 7–9 · v1 · 16 slides · ExamView L4U7–9 · how the test runs → what the app marks (56) and what Neritan marks (24) → the full answer key Q1–Q40 → the Q41 writing rubric → the Q42 speaking script with its picture → reading the result by skill

content: Administer the ExamView Units 7–9 test: play TR 9.3, 9.4 and 9.4a, and run the Q42 speaking prompts from the picture.
Mark the four open responses — Q36, Q37, the Q41 writing and the Q42 speaking — against the publisher's key and rubric.
Read the result by skill (vocabulary 30 · grammar 18 · reading 12 · listening 4 · writing 10 · speaking 10) and pick what to re-teach.
language: Check used to / didn't use to for past habits that have changed.
Check who for people and which for things and animals.
Check the two ditransitive patterns: send something to someone, buy something for someone.
Check the double comparative the more… the more…
